My dear [Sir](../persons.html#1143)

If you are writing to [Tauchnitz](../persons.html#1396),[^1] I hope you will be kind enough to express my best thanks for the very curious and prettily got up book which I am much obliged to you for forwarding to me, the binding is beautiful, and there is much interest in the comparison of the contents. I thank you too for the enclosed review of [Miss Roberts](../persons.html#1244)’ book. I have not heard from her for so long that I begin to think she must be on her way home, and so do not write to her

Yours faithfully

C.M.

Yonge

[^1]: A Leipzig publishing firm, headed by Bernhard, Baron von Tauchnitz (1816-1895), which circulated paperback reprints of many English novels on the continent.
